$comment: Telegram Web K in-page API symbols this project reads through src/telegram/TelegramModelBridge.ts. Kept apart from tweb-dom-contract.json because these are JavaScript identifiers, not DOM tokens, and they carry a different risk: a private API is unversioned and unannounced, so it breaks more quietly than a CSS class. scripts/check-tweb-contract.mjs verifies each symbol still exists upstream.

symbols.note: The assignment that puts the proxy on window. Upstream sets MOUNT_CLASS_TO to the global context unconditionally (config/debug.ts), which is the only reason a page-realm userscript can reach it at all. If this line goes, the bridge goes with it.
